summary_en: ¥1,600M upper limit, 400,000 shares (2.64% of shares outstanding), open-market purchase window 24 July 2026 to 18 September 2026, price ceiling not disclosed.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: SE Holdings and Incubations Co., Ltd. announced on 23 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury stock under Article 156 of the Companies Act (as applied by Article 165(3)). The company will purchase up to 400,000 ordinary shares (2.64% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an aggregate purchase price not to exceed ¥1,600 million via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 24 July 2026 and 18 September 2026. The company cited the need to conduct flexible management in response to changes in economic conditions. No per-share price ceiling was disclosed. As of the announcement date, the company held 1,128,709 treasury shares and had 15,155,517 shares outstanding (ex-treasury).
